mapper.select: SELECT ci.cino, ci.qty FROM tbl_cart_item ci INNER JOIN tbl_cart c ON ci.cart_cno = c.cno WHERE c.member_owner = #{email} AND ci.product_pno = #{pno}

SELECT ci.cino, ci.qty, p.pno, p.pname, p.price, pi.file_name FROM tbl_cart_item ci INNER JOIN tbl_cart c ON ci.cart_cno = c.cno LEFT JOIN tbl_product p ON ci.product_pno = p.pno LEFT JOIN tbl_product_image pi ON pi.pno = p.pno AND pi.ord = 0 WHERE c.member_owner = #{email} ORDER BY ci.cino DESC

SELECT ci.cino, ci.qty, p.pno, p.pname, p.price, pi.file_name FROM tbl_cart_item ci INNER JOIN tbl_cart c ON ci.cart_cno = c.cno LEFT JOIN tbl_product p ON ci.product_pno = p.pno LEFT JOIN tbl_product_image pi ON pi.pno = p.pno AND pi.ord = 0 WHERE c.cno = #{cno} ORDER BY ci.cino DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_cart_item (product_pno, cart_cno, qty) VALUES (#{product.pno}, #{cart.cno}, #{qty})
